[[File:Project_Instinction.png|thumb|right|200px|Project Instinction begins.]]
'''Project Instinction''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] plan created by the [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] at the time, and his modified [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]], [[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]]. The purpose of this plan was an attack on the [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] in order to disrupt the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukians]]' important harvests.

The plan had a number of stages, the first being the harvesting of soil from the planet [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja's]] badlands and loading it aboard a large number of modified [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]]. These tanks were then loaded aboard a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]], which later disgorged them above the planetary shields of Ukio. The tanks then dropped the soil upon the shields, and effectively blocked out the system's sun. Knowing the Ukians would be forced to drop the shields, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] were prepared to use the opportunity to land on the planet's surface. Once a hole in the shields opened up, a small group of [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttles]] descended.

On the planet, one of the shuttles opened to reveal Doctor and several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], who brought out a strange device. They jammed all communications, then activated the device, which immediately began to affect most creatures and sentients within range. It caused the domesticated [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]] to thrash wildly, the wild [[gigaun]]s to stampede off the migration route, and the Ukians and [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] alike to attack anyone nearby. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] and [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|AgriCorps]] member [[Sanya]], both [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitives]], were, with the exception of the former attacking Ganch, less effected by the operation. All three of the devices, however, were destroyed.

Even though the devices were destroyed, the true plan of Passel Argente and [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] worked. Because of the crisis on the planet, Ukio's stock markets were gripped in turmoil, with stock prices plummeting. The wealth of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] allowed them to buy a controlling share of the planet's stocks, thereby effectively owning the planet and all of its important crops.
